title: Almost-linear edit-distance approximation scheme
exact_target: For every fixed rational $\varepsilon \in (0,1)$, is there one randomized logarithmic-word RAM algorithm returning a $(1+\varepsilon )-multiplicative$ upper estimate of ordinary string edit distance with probability $\geq 2/3$ and worst-case expected running time $N^{1+o(1)}$ in total string length N, including all preprocessing, with exact zero output on equal strings?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.

manuscripts.title: An Almost-Linear Approximation Scheme for Edit Distance
